title: Exploring LLM biases to manipulate AI search overview

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the persistence of LLM citations across multiple permutations and prompt variations to identify a preference for information aggregators and resellers over brand-owned content.
Randomly shuffling URLs among search result snippets to measure whether the LLM relies more on the URL string/domain than the actual snippet text when selecting sources.
Shuffling the presentation order of search results to test if the likelihood of a snippet being cited changes based on its position in the context window.
Observing reinforcement learning reward hacking behavior where the trained policy maximizes its selection probability by artificially lengthening search snippets.
